from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,re,shutil
from pathlib import Path
import sys
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from src.ect.paper_bn import source_hashes,write_json,ARTIFACTS,_acceptance

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
folder=ROOT/'results/paper_bn/acceptance_v1'
sources=source_hashes()
review_path=Path('/tmp/ect_bn_producer_review_final2.json')
assert review_path.exists(),'Independent producer review not finalized'
review=json.loads(review_path.read_text())
assert not review.get('issues'),review
shutil.copyfile(review_path,folder/'independent_review.json')
for p in ['/tmp/ect_bn_producer_review.json','/tmp/ect_bn_review_reproduce.py','/tmp/ect_bn_review_reproduction.json']:
    if Path(p).exists():shutil.copyfile(p,folder/Path(p).name)
log=Path('/tmp/ect_bn_final_regression.log').read_text()
match=re.search(r'Ran 309 tests in ([0-9.]+)s',log)
assert match and log.rstrip().endswith('OK')
assert 'skipped' not in log and 'FAILED' not in log
(folder/'regression.log').write_text(log,newline='\n')
write_json(folder/'regression.json',dict(status='passed',test_count=309,skipped=0,elapsed_seconds=float(match.group(1)),
    execution_context='actual CUDA accessible',command='.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v',
    code_sha256=sources,log_sha256=sha(folder/'regression.log')))
files={};runs=[]
for device in ('cpu','cuda'):
    run=folder/device;report=json.loads((run/'report.json').read_text())
    proof_path=folder/f'{device}_verification.json';proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
    assert report['code_sha256']==sources and report['sample_counts']=={'train':40,'validation':40}
    assert report['environment']['device']==device and proof['device']==device
    assert proof['same_device_calibration_exact'] and proof['calibration_buffer_max_abs_error']==0
    assert proof['maximum_metric_error']==0 and proof['prediction_counts']==report['sample_counts']
    for p in [run/'report.json',*[run/n for n in ARTIFACTS],proof_path]:files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]=sha(p)
    runs.append(dict(device=device,run_dir=run.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),verification_path=proof_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()))
for p in folder.iterdir():
    if p.is_file() and p.name!='acceptance.json':files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]=sha(p)
transfer=folder/'cuda_cpu_verification.json';p=json.loads(transfer.read_text())
assert p['status']=='verified' and p['device']=='cpu' and p['maximum_metric_error']==0
assert p['prediction_counts']=={'train':40,'validation':40} and p['checks']['prediction_class_mismatches']==0
acceptance=dict(schema_version=1,status='verified',protocol='paper_bn_acceptance_v1',created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    code_sha256=sources,files_sha256=files,runs=runs,cpu_transfer_verification_path=transfer.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
    checks={k:True for k in ['cpu_calibration','actual_cuda_calibration','independent_calibration_replay','parameters_unchanged',
        'original_weights_unchanged','independent_predictions_metrics','cuda_cpu_migration','full_gpu_regression','independent_producer_review']},
    note='Implementation/device acceptance only: 40 train/40 validation, no model optimization.',
    execution_script=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(),sha256=sha(__file__)))
assert not (folder/'acceptance.json').exists()
write_json(folder/'.acceptance.pending.json',acceptance)
_acceptance(ROOT,folder/'.acceptance.pending.json')
(folder/'.acceptance.pending.json').rename(folder/'acceptance.json')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='verified',acceptance_sha256=sha(folder/'acceptance.json'),files=len(files))))
